summary: Addus HealthCare, Inc., an Illinois subsidiary of Addus HomeCare Corporation, entered into an Equity and Asset Purchase Agreement with AccentCare, Inc. to acquire the seller's personal and community care business outside New York for $275,000,000 in cash, subject to customary working capital adjustments. The transaction involves ten transferred entities plus certain assets of AccentCare Home Health of Mountain Valley. Closing is conditioned on regulatory approvals, HSR waiting period expiration, and other customary conditions, with the 8-K filed September 14, 2026 and dated September 12, 2026. Watch regulatory clearance timing and any potential divestiture requirements.
